title: ros2 node list shows killed nodes: ros2 daemon stale entries, --no-daemon and daemon restart, measured
excerpt: A node killed with kill -9 stayed in ros2 node list for about 20 s with Fast DDS and 6 s with Cyclone DDS; Ctrl-C and kill cleared at once. --no-daemon, daemon restart and --spin-time compared, plus empty lists after a daemon restart. Measured on Humble.
